title: autotune: add defaults for batching/caching + quant profiles and unit-econ tooling
author: Priya Raman
description:
Motivation: we continue to see large variance in per-token costs across customers due to suboptimal defaults for batching, prefix/KV caching, and quantization. This PR adds conservative autotune defaults and exposes quantization profile suggestions to the operator, plus a small unit-economics (UEcon) CLI and dashboard pipeline to make cost tradeoffs visible.

What this change does: Adds a new `autotune.defaults` module that supplies safe batching and caching defaults at both the node and per-model routing layer; introduces a quantization-profiles catalog with recommended profiles per model-family and memory/latency targets; wires a UEcon metrics exporter and a CLI `redwood uecon estimate` that produces per-route cost/latency estimates from sampled traces.

Notes: The description below includes implementation summary, testing, rollout plan, and backward compatibility notes. See commits for the exact changes.

release_notes: Added conservative autotune defaults for batching and caching; introduced quantization profile catalog (v0) with recommended profiles; new UEcon estimator CLI and metrics exporter for per-route cost/latency estimation. Backwards compatible; features are opt-in via config where applicable.
